title: An installation-wide token can still be minted through the installation listing after a 422 token refusal
resolution: GithubApi has only asApp, typed to the App JWT routes, and asInstallation, which needs the route's repository; a 422 refusal resolves each repository by the App's JWT. A test that every token request names repositories, the 422 fallback included, failed before the fix.

title: Redirects bypass the repository allowlist of the conformance guard
resolution: The guard sends every request with redirect manual and refuses any 3xx answer without following it; a test with a same-host redirect to petarnenov/taskelith, an external host, and a redirect chain failed before the fix.

title: The 30-second propagation deadline is not enforced by awaitRefusal
resolution: awaitRefusals checks the window before each attempt, bounds a hanging attempt by the clock's timeout, counts no answer after the window, and shares one window among an ending's probes; fake-clock tests for these cases failed before the fix.

title: The long run counts any failed result, not only forbidden, as a credential refusal
resolution: Every refusal check of the long run requires forbidden and reports another code as a finding; plugin and fixture answers are read with the suite's readUntrustedResult and readRunCredential. Tests with unavailable, internal, and malformed probe results failed before the fix.

title: Known secrets shorter than eight characters or JSON-escaped survive the evidence scan
resolution: The scan checks every known secret, as written and as JSON escapes it, and the settings refuse a webhook secret shorter than eight characters; a test through JSON.stringify and a short-secret test failed before the fix.

title: The evidence redaction and scan miss fine-grained GitHub tokens
resolution: A local redaction rule and the scan cover ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_, and github_pat_ tokens; a test of every family failed before the fix.

title: Long-run findings copy untrusted exception messages
resolution: The long run names a thrown value only by describeThrown's fixed category; a test with a token in a thrown message failed before the fix.

title: Minted credentials stay active after successful and failed runs
resolution: After the repository cleanup the run revokes every token the guard saw minted, renewals included, and records already-ended tokens and each failed revocation in the report, which fails the run; the test of the revocation report failed before the fix, and a renewal test shows both tokens witnessed.

title: Every branch-deletion 422 is reported as successful cleanup
resolution: A 422 to a branch deletion is ambiguous, so the cleanup reads the ref again and counts the step done only on 404; a test with a missing and a remaining ref failed before the fix.

title: Cleanup silently accepts a listing truncated at the page limit
resolution: Open pull requests are paged with @octokit/plugin-paginate-rest to completion, and a listing longer than 50 pages fails; matching refs come in one answer. A test with 51 full pages failed before the fix.

title: The Octokit accepted status contradicts the register's admission rule
resolution: By the coordinator's decision the rows stay candidate in docs/dependencies.md and docs/g3-dependencies.md, with the gathered live evidence and the open adoption, upgrade, and recovery evidence, and the exception sentence is removed.

title: The added propagation requirement leaves contradictory immediate-refusal requirements intact
resolution: The delta modifies the draft port and three credential requirements so that ends apply the window from the operation's return while never-granted access is refused at once; the port rises to 0.3.0, and the archive passed on a scratch copy.

title: New timing tests depend on real scheduling
resolution: The window tests run the in-memory SCM on a fixed service clock moved only by the fixture's sleeps and assert exact latencies.

title: Design and verification wording still describes the obsolete build-phase scope
resolution: The design separates the build phase from the delivered scope, and verification states that only the tooling read the secret files while agents got paths and redacted evidence.
